value.lines: iterable of dicts {"category": str, "amount_cents": int} (line totals)
value.region: customer region string; None = unknown customer -> 0% tax, no discount; region not in rates.csv raises KeyError
value.discount_pct: customer discount percent number (10 means 10%), default 0
value.rounding: exact Decimal math; final tax rounded to cent ROUND_HALF_UP

why: Proposed API for tax.py; invoice.py must not compute tax rules itself

value.pricing.unit_price: unit_price(sku) -> Decimal; Decimal("0") if SKU unknown
value.pricing.customer_name: customer_name(customer_id) -> str; empty string if unknown customer
value.pricing.price_multiplier: price_multiplier(customer_id) -> Decimal; 0.90 = 10% off; Decimal("1") if unknown customer
value.tax.tax_for: tax_for(customer_id, lines, discount) -> (rate_multiplier Decimal e.g. 1.0825, tax_amount Decimal quantized to cent); lines = list of (sku, quantity, line_amount Decimal) for known SKUs only, in order; discount = positive Decimal discount amount; unknown customer -> (Decimal("1"), Decimal("0.00"))

why: Superseded: adopting pricing's published API (get_item/get_customer) and agent2's tax_api (compute_tax/get_rate)
invoice.py will call compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct) and get_rate(region)
